title: Limited engineering Git baseline and fail-closed commit CI
owner: luciano; engineering with independent scoped review
approved_by: User-approved in chat: usemos github autorizo commit acotado
objective: Create a minimal local engineering commit, install a local staged-snapshot check and prepare GitHub Actions without credentials, datasets, trading execution or remote mutations.
scope_in: Explicit allowlist of audited metadata and engineering code; preserve all historical source bytes.
Trusted out-of-candidate baseline and checker; verify staged/tree paths, modes, object identities and hashes before materialization or executing tests.
Offline synthetic regressions and current confirmed-exposure BLOCKED disposition from a temporary snapshot, not unstaged workspace files.
GitHub-hosted workflow pinned checkout action, read-only permissions, trusted baseline commit variable, no auto-install or deployment.
Repository-local Git author configuration explicitly supplied by user and one limited initial commit.
scope_out: No git add .; no market payloads, credentials, trading databases, archives, live engine or research pipelines in commit.
No remote repository creation, remote configuration, push, branch protection mutation or GitHub job dispatch.
No LIVE, research, acquisition, optimization, backtesting, orders or canonical phase/gate closure.
No reset/removal of user workspace files or rewriting historical hashes.
files_forbidden: Existing sealed metadata and audit sources (commit byte-identical only)
data_allowed: Explicitly allowlisted code and governance metadata; synthetic test fixtures.
data_forbidden: Market dataset/holdout payloads, secret values, trading DB contents.

acceptance_criteria.description: Initial staged set is exact engineering allowlist, no protected payload paths; canonical bytes unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Pre-read path/mode/object checks, digest verification and staged-set audit.

acceptance_criteria.description: Staged/tree snapshot check cannot pass using unstaged safe files; missing/changed baseline or incident fails closed.
Offline snapshot guard regressions pass and M0 actual result remains BLOCKED with verified exposure.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: 43 guard tests plus strict registry result check in disposable engineering-only snapshot.

acceptance_criteria.description: Independent scoped review confirms local hook and prepared workflow; no claims of active remote CI, branch protection or global sandbox.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Independent source review and snapshot test reproduction.

rollback_plan: Preserve user files and resulting local commit. No automatic destructive rollback or rewriting history. Hook can block rather than disable controls; remote activation remains separate.

risks.risk: Candidate replaces its checker/manifest to grant its own acceptance.
risks.mitigation: Local trust copies outside index; GitHub trusted commit variable and trusted checker from a separate checkout. Candidate bytes never select trust.

risks.risk: Pre-commit skipped or candidate workflow changed outside a protected branch.
risks.mitigation: Local hook is bypassable. Remote rulesets/independent approval remain required and unconfigured; do not claim mandatory CI yet.

risks.risk: Runner dependencies absent or uncontrolled environment.
risks.mitigation: Check preinstalled versions; fail on absence, no downloads. No secret injection; frozen approved source only. Full network/process sandbox not claimed.

notes: A commit/check success is engineering only; FASE61/M0/LIVE remain BLOCKED. Initial baseline is frozen; later code admission needs a newly reviewed trusted baseline, not self-updated candidate metadata. SPEC remains APPROVED, not CLOSED.
